pre_stated_hypothesis.name: Illiquidity Shock Mean Reversion (Amihud Proxy on Real Quote Volume)
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Compute Amihud illiquidity proxy ILLIQ=|ret1|/(quote_volume+eps) and its causal z-score (168h). When illiq_z>1.5 and |ret1|>=0.1% (thin-liquidity shock), fade the move direction: long if ret1<0, short if ret1>0. Exit on illiq_z<0, max hold 12h, or flip. Execution t->t+1. WF 720/168/168, cost grid 0-40bps, B&H benchmark on same OOS windows.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 uses high vol_z LEVEL surge for momentum continuation; C45 uses |ret|/volume illiquidity ratio, not vol_z level.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades HIGH volume climax (vol_z level); C45 fades illiquidity SHOCKS (|ret|/volume z-score), different transformation.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 continues on LOW vol_z dry-up breakout; C45 fades on HIGH illiquidity ratio shocks.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 confirms breakouts on volume expansion (rising vol_z); C45 uses return-normalized illiquidity ratio, no breakout condition.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c43: C43 fades volume-price divergence (weak vol_z confirmation of extremes); C45 fades illiquidity spikes (|ret|/volume).
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c44: C44 trend-follows on vol_z ROC acceleration; C45 mean-reverts on illiquidity ratio shocks — opposite direction/mechanic and different signal.

summary.edge_rule: exposure>0 AND all cost-grid slices OOS net>0 AND OOS net>B&H on same OOS windows (pre-stated, fail-closed)
